about_the_game:
“Lots of Cats on an Adventure” is a game where you find hidden cats in comic strips, meow!

 

On a peaceful day, humans (a.k.a. cat servants) were abducted by aliens!

One brave cat couldn’t just sit back and watch, so they set off on an adventure to gather a crew to rescue their beloved humans….

Find the cats hidden in the beautiful and diverse hand-drawn landscapes, and join the cat friends on their wacky adventure, meow!

Find Over 2000 Cats and Special Items!

  • Part 1 (free): 5+1 main landscapes, 5 interactable comic strips, 750+ cats, 250 items

  • Part 2 (DLC): 5+1 main landscapes, 5 interactable comic strips, 750+ cats, 250 items

Main Features

  • All comic strips and main landscapes are connected through story progression.

  • Hints can be used once per minute.

  • No penalty for clicking on a spot without a cat. Search freely.

  • Has an original soundtrack, with unique tracks featured in each episode. Another BGM set is also available, so you can choose the one that you like best.
